description: Source code for a Zephyr RTOS watchdog driver for NXP MCUX WWDT hardware, including configuration, setup, disable, timeout installation, feeding, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: mcux_wwdt_setup
methods.description: Initializes and starts the watchdog timer with the configured settings.

methods.name: mcux_wwdt_disable
methods.description: Deinitializes the watchdog timer, disabling it.

methods.name: mcux_wwdt_install_timeout
methods.description: Configures and installs a timeout period for the watchdog.

methods.name: mcux_wwdt_feed
methods.description: Refreshes (kicks) the watchdog to prevent it from resetting the system.

methods.name: mcux_wwdt_init
methods.description: Performs initial setup, including configuring interrupts.
